name: Royal Crown
description: Order, discipline, and absolute authority. The Royal Crown commands the realm's armies.

name: Silver Order
description: Holy knights and clerics dedicated to purging the undead and demonic corruption.

name: Druid Circle
description: Protectors of the Greenwood. Masters of nature, poisons, and slowing vines.

name: Merchant League
description: Wealth is power. The League provides gold bonuses and discounts.

name: Shadow Syndicate
description: Assassins, smugglers, and thieves. Masters of critical strikes.

name: Ash Coven
description: Warlocks and witches harnessing dark fire and curses.

name: Gear Mechanics
description: Inventors and engineers specializing in ballistics and explosive tech.

name: Outcasts
description: Mutants, allied orcs, and rebels looking for a place in the world.
